_about_nba_modules: Basketball inherits the NBA (Architect 2026-11-06 18:07 UK: "NBA and basketball, they're the same thing ... NBA is a league, basketball is a sport. So you should inherit all its attributes of NBA"). Every NBA module (engine/monitor/output/backtest nba_*.py and run_nba.py) says what world basketball / NCAA has of it: covers / twin / todo (priority + open issue) / n/a (why). tests/sport_parity_test.py fails on an unlisted NBA module, so a new NBA feature cannot merge without saying what the rest of basketball gets. The bots already place world basketball singles at the NBA stakes and rules (2026-11-05).
